biotools.summary: Alternative polyadenylation (APA) is an important post-transcriptional regulation mechanism which occurs in most human genes. This tool facilitates the discovery of novel APA sites from RNAseq data by leveraging cleanUpdTSeq to fine tune identified APA sites.

bioschemas.name: InPAS
bioschemas.summary: Alternative polyadenylation (APA) is one of the important post- transcriptional regulation mechanisms which occurs in most human genes. InPAS facilitates the discovery of novel APA sites and the differential usage of APA sites from RNA-Seq data. It leverages cleanUpdTSeq to fine tune identified APA sites by removing false sites.
